My dear [Anna](../persons.html#195)
I am sorry to say I cannot anyhow come on the 16th for it is our [School](../others.html#107) examination day, and it will not be over in time.

What shall we do without our Chairman who was a tower of strength on the right side

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
